subject: Flatspinning at the Dam
author: Abernyte
body:
The instructions below desribe how to clip the wall at Rockridge Dam to get the 1,500 + spins.

The Run-up

There are several popular starting points:

  1. Start down in the quarry and boost up to the quarry entrance, drift through the entrance, with the divider on your left, and then boost to the ramp. This approach avoids a lot of traffic and can provide a lot of speed but can be tricky to master.
  2. Start inside the entrance to the quarry for a straight run to the ramp. You won’t have as much speed as you will starting elsewhere but this does offer a straight run to the ramp and you don’t have any blind corners for those magically appearing busses to pop up behind.
  3. Start at the intersection of S. Mountain and Hans. Boost around the corner on S. Mountain then on to the ramp. This offers a nice compromise. It is a decent length run so you can build up speed.
  4. Start on W. Lake Drive and use the dirt shortcut that runs between W. Lake and Hans. Go through the intersection of Geldard, Hans and S. Mountain then around the corner on S. Mountain to the ramp. This offers additional run up so you reach maximum speed sooner than starting at the intersection of S. Mountain and Hans. The problem is you may lose some of that speed dodging the extra traffic you have to pass through.
Once you are headed for the ramp you want to approach the ramp from as straight on as possible - basically you want to just miss the right hand fence on the side of S. Mountain as you approach the ramp.
 
Hitting the wall: 
 
Getting a high spin requires clipping the wall on the right side of the ramp. The specifics depend on the car your in and your speed but basically what you need to do is go into an e-brake turn to the right and clip the left front corner of the car on the right hand wall.
Upon impact you want your car to be roughly perpendicular to the ramp (at a 90 degree angle to it) so that all of the momentum you have is translated into the spin. If you approach at too shallow an angle, say 45 degrees, you'll most likely wreck, as your forward momentum will carry you into the wall.
 
Best car to use is the Hot Rod. The P12 works also but the Hot Rod is far superior.
 
There are several good videos on Youtube. Do a search for Flatspin. Here is one:
pl.youtube.com/watch
